resources.string: XML 1.0 well-formedness only, not schema validation or sanitization. DTDs, entity declarations, unresolved entities and external resources are rejected; nothing is fetched. Format attributes only places each start-tag attribute on a new indented line. For accepted documents, text, quoted attribute values, comments, CDATA, processing instructions and inter-element whitespace are preserved. The conservative safety check rejects any DOCTYPE- or ENTITY-like declaration text, even when inert inside comments, CDATA or processing instructions. No tree indentation or minification.
Malformed XML or invalid XML 1.0 characters
DTD, entity declaration or unresolved entity is not supported
Unsupported XML version, operation or secure parser configuration
